bar.label: GAID places
bar.workspaceTip: GAID Workspace: install Workflows and analyse your data
bar.connectTip: GAID Connect: make and share geoscience Workflows
bar.libraryTip: Open your papers and research notes

origin.gaidTip: A literature digest the AI agent made from library papers with a general Workflow
origin.geminiTip: A summary imported from a file exported from Gemini Notebook. Never used as a citation source

library.rowLineUnmatched: {count} papers · {unmatched} sources not in the library · {date}
library.digestNote: A literature digest is material prepared from several papers in advance. When a Workflow starts, the AI agent reads it first and checks citations against the pages of the original papers.

detail.stale: {count} papers were added to this folder after the digest was made.
detail.noPdf: For {count} papers without a PDF only the record and abstract were read.

make.title: Make a literature digest
make.context: The AI agent reads the chosen papers, writes a comparison or summary with a citation list, and adds it to the library.
make.papersHint: Choose a library folder or papers. Only these papers are read.
make.noPdf: For {count} papers without a PDF only the record and abstract are read.
make.kindHint: Made with one of the general Workflows in GAID.

kinds.compareHint: Two or more papers: compares claims, methods, data and limits in one table with page citations.
kinds.summarizeHint: Summarizes each paper's objective, methods, findings and significance separately. No comparison table.
kinds.methodsHint: Compares methods for the research question by strengths, weaknesses and the data they need.

make.question: Research question
make.questionHint: The digest is organised around it. Write one or two sentences.
make.whereHint: The AI agent reads in a chat of this project, and the output file stays in its 문헌정리 folder.
make.whereAttached: Project this folder is attached to
make.footer: When finished it enters the library as not reviewed.

import.title: Import a Gemini Notebook result
import.context: Adds a report or table downloaded from Gemini Notebook to the library as an external summary.
import.fileHint: Word, PDF, Markdown, text, CSV · up to 30 MB
import.name: Name
import.linkFromFolder: Filled in from the notebook address saved on the folder.
import.coversHint: DOIs and titles found in the file were matched with the library. Keep only the right ones.
import.notInLibrary: Not in the library · not linked
import.limit: External summaries enter as not reviewed and are never used as citation sources. The file is stored only in this PC's library, and GAID sends nothing to Google.
import.footer: Adds it to the folder 포천 자철석 PGI.

start.papersLine: {count} papers · all attached to this project
start.papersAttached: The AI agent uses these papers as citation sources.
start.digestWhy: Recommended because it covers every source paper. It is not reviewed, so the AI agent checks each claim it uses in results against the original paper's page.
start.digestHintExternal: Covers {covers} of {total} source papers · read for reference only
start.digestNoneHint: The AI agent looks up and reads paper pages whenever it needs them.

sum.digestNote: The AI agent reads it before the analysis. Citations point to the original papers' pages, not to this digest.
sum.papersNote: Only content missing from the digest or pages to check are read from the original papers.

authoring.title: Make a new Workflow
authoring.context: Makes a Workflow draft from papers, research notes, literature digests and data.

panel.title: Choose sources from the library
panel.context: With a literature digest, the AI agent reads the digest first instead of whole papers to make its questions.
panel.withPapers: Also add the {count} papers it covers as sources
panel.withPapersHint: The evidence view beside each question opens the original paper's page. Only the pages needed are read.
